failure_cause: Tier 1 pitch error along the note, worst frame = 3.36% misses <= 3.0% (judge floor on a perfect echo: 2.53%); Tier 1 spectrogram correlation, log-mel = 0.728 misses >= 0.8 (judge floor on a perfect echo: 0.976)

judge_floor.note: metrics of target * clap (band-limited): the floor set by the judge and the clap, not the design

caveats: 1 cm and 2 cm posts: forward/side scattering off the analytic cylinder at the 4 kHz grid (1 cm forward 1.04 dB, 90-degree 1.77 dB; 2 cm forward 1.47 dB, 90-degree 0.43 dB) (backscatter within 1 dB; cause measured at the 4 kHz grid: dipole part ~10 % strong for sub-cell posts); effect on dense-field echoes is not bounded; shadowing and multiple scattering are checked by self-convergence only, not against an exact solution

stretch.definition: Tier 1 echo(t) ~ Tier 0 echo of the same posts at t (1 + eps); ranges scaled by 1 + eps_applied; residual refit after each Tier 1 run

design_study_tier0.what: Tier 0 design study, stage 1 (2D mode for losses/judges, 3D for level)
design_study_tier0.selection: designs compared by Tier 0 spectrogram loss (window_loss) and its jitter robustness only; pitch error and log-mel correlation (judges) are recorded for information and never used to choose
design_study_tier0.jitter: radial (along the ray from the source), Gaussian sigma, seeds (11, 12, 13)

h2_tier1_vs_tier0.what: H2: Tier 1 vs Tier 0 on the same posts, and the Tier 0 radial jitter that reproduces the residue

pitch.rule: midway between worst positive and best mistuning control (accepted and perfect echo +-1, +-2 semitones; 3rd-best clap), 5-cent rounding, >= 20 c from both sides, below 50 c

listening_verdict.quote: listening to the results, I think all of them are pass
listening_verdict.note: A human judgment, recorded as such; not an automated pass. Not a blind test: the listener knew each target, and knowing the target helps a listener hear it. A blind check is prepared in runs/_criteria/blind_test/. Written only on the runs the owner heard (metrics_v2.ACCEPTED_RUNS, pinned to the newest final run per test before the statement, which the ledger logs at 15:04). Which of the two stage-2 designs the owner heard is not recorded; pinned to the first design (20261125-122003-s2) pending confirmation.
